name: MeetFox
description_en:
MeetFox is a product in the Scheduling category. Its directory profile covers Multi-Location Scheduling, Resource Scheduling, Reservations, Payment Processing, Online Scheduling, Meeting Room Booking, Group Scheduling, Employee Scheduling.

Additional listed capabilities include Calendar Management, Automated Scheduling, Appointment Scheduling. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $10.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: assign work periods to employees; organize dated events and scheduling information; offer available times and manage bookings. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
MeetFox 属于预约与排程软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括多地点排程、资源排程、预订管理、支付处理、在线排程、会议室预订、群组排程、员工排班。

资料还列出日历管理、自动排程、预约安排。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $10.00. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：为员工安排工作时段；整理日程事件和排期信息；提供可预约时段并管理预约。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
